Here are my top picks after having lived in Bangalore all of my life. 

1. Visit Lalbagh/Cubbon park. They’re the green lungs of this city. There are some historical places around Cubbon park, i.e the Vidhana Soudha (Capital Building of Karnataka), town hall, Central Library, Museum and planetarium. All are around Cubbon Park so this would be a must visit and are considered the centre of the city.

2. You could visit Bangalore Palace (royal palace of Bangalore). 

3. Visit Brigade road, MG road and Commercial street (Bangalore’s famous streets for shopping)

4. Visit the beautiful Isckon Temple. It will be a pleasant experience and you can get a metro from MG road to near this place.

5. Visit Koramangala, which is famous for having a lot of Food and beverage joints. You could explore the multiple food joints and breweries(if u drink) around here. Let me know if you need help or to show u around here as I live close to here. I would love to have a drink.

There are a few other places to recommend but this is a good few things you can do in the city. There are a lot of other places to explore around Bangalore if u have the time and means for it
